title: What to buy
sub: The neckband gives all the electronics and all the sound parts (board, battery, both speakers, mic). Besides it, only small hardware bits; the bigger speakers, a battery and a mic capsule are optional fallbacks. Exact items in COMPONENTS.md.

groups.label: The neckband: everything electronic and everything you hear
groups.note: Pair it and try it before you open it. It has no published teardown: measure its board, battery and speakers and set them on "Make it your size" before printing.

items.name: boAt Rockerz 255 Pro+ Bluetooth neckband
items.for: Everything electronic and everything you hear: its board and battery (in the pod), its 2 speakers (in the ear pockets) and its mic (on the boom). Any neckband works once measured

items.name: Tactile switches, 6 × 6 × 7 mm (through-hole, round actuator)
items.for: The 3 buttons (the height matters: each actuator reaches up into its dome)

items.name: M2 heat-set inserts (3.2 mm hole, 4 mm long) and M2 × 6 countersunk screws
3M VHB tape 4910 or 5952, about 1.1 mm
items.for: Sticks the pod to the shell, and the cable channel (thin strips under its flanges)

items.name: Neutral-cure clear silicone
items.for: The cable holes, and dabs to hold the cables on the shell

items.name: 2 mm aluminium craft (armature) wire and 5 mm heat-shrink
Foam windscreen for a lapel mic (or a scrap of open-cell foam)
28–30 AWG wire
items.for: The switches' wires, and extending the mic and speaker wires

items.name: Thin 4-core cable, about 4 mm (an old USB cable works)
Thin shielded cable, about 3 mm (an old 3.5 mm audio cable works)

groups.label: Optional: only if needed
groups.note: Not needed for the standard build: the neckband's own speakers, battery and mic are used.

items.name: 40 mm 32 Ω speakers (helmet speakers, or bare 40 mm 32 ohm mylar speakers), about 5.5 mm thick
items.for: Only if the earbuds' own speakers are too quiet at speed (try them first). They fit the same puck. Not 8 Ω (too much for the neckband's amplifier)

items.name: 502540 LiPo battery, 3.7 V about 500 mAh, with protection board
items.for: Only if the neckband's own battery doesn't fit the pod (40 × 25 × 5 mm)

items.name: 6 mm electret mic capsule + 2.2 kΩ resistor
items.for: Only if the neckband's MEMS mic can't be moved (see the README)

items.name: 3D printing service
items.for: About 30–35 g of PETG / ASA and 5 g of TPU

totals: about ₹1,800–3,200 (est.), most of it the neckband
note: All prices here are estimates (not checked on listings).
